kept.title: Road resurfacing nearby may affect sidewalks and curbs
kept.detail: Maple Grove Ave (190 m away) is listed as Active with a timeline of Q2 2024 - Q3 2025 (Carry-Over). West Lodge Ave (303 m away) is planned for Q2 2026 - Q4 2026, and Close Ave (162 m away) for Q2 2027 - Q4 2027. The listed work includes sidewalk and curb repairs and may close lanes or the whole road. The data does not show how pedestrian routes would be handled during the work.

cites.quote: MAPLE GROVE AVE; From: BROCK AVE; To: O'HARA AVE | status: Active | timeline: Q2 2024 - Q3 2025 (Carry-Over) | 190 m from the point
including repairs of any damaged sidewalks and curbs. Work may include the closure of individual lanes or the entire road.

kept.title: Sidewalk clearing starts at 2 cm of snow and takes about 12 hours
kept.detail: The City's report says sidewalk clearing begins once snow reaches 2 cm. City crews usually finish a full clearing cycle within about 12 hours, so sidewalks may not be cleared for some time after snowfall.

cites.quote: the City begins sidewalk clearing once snow accumulation reaches 2 cm.
City crews typically complete a full sidewalk clearing cycle within approximately 12 hours once accumulation reaches 2 cm.

kept.title: Public laneways are salted but not plowed
kept.detail: For public laneways, the service level is salting only, within 24 hours after snowfall ends. Snow plowing is not provided. A laneway resurfacing on Milky Way (205 m away) is also listed for 2026.

cites.quote: salting only, within 24 hours after the end of snowfall, to manage icy conditions; snow plowing is not provided.
